- Music & sound — parts of the soundtrack and sound effects are created with AI audio tools and curated by us.

Kerf - Sawmill Tycoon was made almost entirely with AI tools. The developer directed the work, chose what went into the game and approved every result, but did not model, rig or write code by hand. What that means for the content that ships in the game:
- Code: written by an AI coding assistant.
- Characters: generated by an AI 3D tool from AI-generated reference images, then rigged and set up in the game by the AI assistant.
- Other 3D models: some came from an AI 3D tool - a vehicle and environment props such as rocks, mountains and bushes. The rest, including the valley, the buildings, the machines and the trees, were built in 3D software by the AI assistant writing scripts.
- Animation: all character animation was generated with an AI motion tool.
- Music: all of the in-game music was generated with an AI music tool.
- Sound: some sound effects were generated with an AI sound tool; the rest were sourced from sound libraries by the developer.
- Text: the in-game text was written with AI assistance, and the translations from English and Polish into the other 13 supported languages were made with AI.
Everything was reviewed and approved by the developer before release.

In our ongoing effort to bring you a unique and immersive gaming experience, we’ve integrated AI-assisted tools into the creation of some of our in-game art. These tools have been used to inspire and enhance the visual style of our game, helping to generate distinct and creative elements that complement our hand-crafted assets.
By utilizing AI, we’ve been able to explore new artistic possibilities, ensuring that our game features a vibrant and visually compelling world. However, every AI-assisted asset has been carefully reviewed, refined, and curated by our development team to align with our artistic vision and maintain a cohesive aesthetic throughout the game.
Our primary goal is to deliver a game that is both visually stunning and enjoyable, and AI has been one of the many tools we've used to achieve that. We hope you enjoy the result as much as we enjoyed creating it!

This game uses AI in two ways.
(1) Pre-generated: the following content was created with the help of
generative AI tools during development and was reviewed, selected and
edited by the developer before inclusion:
- Music - created with Suno
- Sound effects - created with ElevenLabs
- Visual assets (in-game and store/marketing images) - created with
FLUX.2 [klein] (Black Forest Labs)
(2) Live-generated: two optional features use live AI on our servers.
First, an AI chat NPC - "KAL", a radio operator. When a player mentions
KAL in the in-game text chat, a short reply is generated live,
server-side, via the Google Gemini API (text only). KAL is locked to a
fixed, developer-written persona and curated game data; replies are
clearly labeled as NPC messages, limited to three short sentences,
strictly rate-limited, ephemeral, and never affect gameplay, balance or
purchases. Second, clan emblems: when a clan is founded, a single
poster-style emblem image is generated server-side via the Google
Gemini image API from a fixed, developer-written prompt template. The
founder's clan name, tag and description only set the mood of the
image; the only text allowed in the image is the short clan tag.
Regeneration is limited to once per week per clan.

Music (BGM & Tracks): Suno and Udio were used for initial music generation concepts. Our sound artist then refined, mixed, mastered, and remade these tracks to create the final in-game BGM and rhythm game audio. (Sound effects and other audio elements were produced directly without AI.)
Graphics (In-game Icons & Illustrations): Gemini and ChatGPT were used to generate initial drafts for select in-game icons and illustrations. Our graphic artists then directly edited, corrected, and retouched these assets to refine them for the final game.
AI was used to generate the game translations, and the store translations (in combination with human efforts guarantee consistency and clarity).
Some visual assets in Poker Clicker were initially created with AI image generation tools, then manually redrawn and refined by the developer to fit the game's visual style.
Some assets on the Steam page were created using AI
Generative AI was used only to create the artwork displayed on the main menu screen. All other content including gameplay assets, UI, audio, and code was produced without generative AI
AI used in this game includes several language translations and some textures.
This game uses AI-generated assets made during development. No AI content is generated during gameplay.

We are a team of two developers with a limited budget, so we use AI to assist with certain illustration assets, such as character portraits, icons, and backgrounds.
However, all core game assets—including UI HUD and UI interface, enemy 3D models and animations, weapons, and environments are created by the two developers themselves.
About 50% of the visuals in this game are AI-generated

All card art is created by Wise Wizard Games' incredibly-talented full-time lead artist.  He used AI tools to iterate on, refine, and polish each of the 321 unique pieces of art. Other artists on our team also used AI tools to create animations based on the card art.
This game uses AI software to create its music.
